shots.title: The Accord of Sixty-Four
shots.speaker: CHRONICLE OF AETHELGARD
shots.caption: For a thousand winters, Aethelgard endured under the Accord of Sixty-Four — an ancient pact binding Ivory and Obsidian to the Sacred Laws of the Board.
shots.prompt: Slow sweeping aerial dolly-in across a colossal sunlit marble chessboard kingdom stretching toward a grand medieval ivory citadel on golden cliffs. Golden sunbeams pierce drifting clouds while shimmering golden dust motes float gently through the air. Carved ivory chess warriors — armored Knights, hooded Bishops, towering Rooks, and royal sovereigns — stand in noble, breathing formation along the marble battlements, pennants and cloaks rippling gently in a warm highland breeze. Hand-painted fantasy oil painting aesthetic, 24fps cinematic lens. Audio: majestic swelling orchestral strings and distant warm French horns over soft mountain wind.

shots.title: The Shattering of the Black Crown
shots.speaker: MALAKOR, THE UNBOUND KING
shots.caption: "No sovereign kneels to sixty-four squares!" Shattering his Black Crown at the edge of the world, Malakor tore open the Rift — unleashing an army bound by no rule of chess.
shots.prompt: Dramatic low-angle push-in at the shattered rim of a colossal dark chessboard under storm-torn crimson skies. The towering Obsidian Monarch Malakor in jagged volcanic armor raises his broken black crown and slams it downward, sending a shockwave of glowing molten cracks across the marble squares. Behind him, a swirling crimson abyssal Rift erupts with rising glowing embers as dark armored Obsidian Footmen and spiked Shadow Charger warhorses surge forward off the ruined board. Hand-painted dark-fantasy cinematic oil style, intense chiaroscuro rim lighting, 24fps. Audio: thunderous obsidian shatter, deep subterranean bass boom, roaring Rift fire, and a booming war horn.

shots.title: The Last Line of Pawns
shots.speaker: ROYAL VANGUARD DISPATCH
shots.caption: The Court is scattered across the Ivory Ranks. Only a line of humble Pawns remains to hold the first bastion — rally the Royal Set before the Citadel Gate falls!
shots.prompt: Tight heroic tracking shot gliding low along a frontline rank of carved ivory Pawn spearmen standing guard upon a warm travertine marble chess square at dusk. Long dramatic shadows stretch across the chessboard as red stormlight flickers on the distant horizon. The ivory Pawns plant their halberds and raise their gilded shields in crisp unison, dust puffing off the marble tiles as distant crimson sparks drift across the sky. Tactile dark-fantasy oil painting in motion, 24fps. Audio: synchronized metallic spear plant on stone, crisp war drum pulse, and rising heroic brass motif.

shots.title: Arch-Cantor Malyss in the Blizzard
shots.speaker: ARCH-CANTOR MALYSS
shots.caption: Vaelor has fallen, yet the northern frontier cracks open into an abyss of ice. Through the blizzard marches Arch-Cantor Malyss, her ember-lantern knitting broken obsidian back to life.
shots.prompt: Atmospheric lateral tracking shot across a wind-swept icy chessboard bridge spanning a bottomless blue glacier chasm during a howling blizzard. Snowflakes whip diagonally across the frame. In dark tattered crimson-trimmed robes, Arch-Cantor Malyss raises a glowing crimson ember staff; ribbons of eerie red Rift-light arc from her lantern to mend the cracked iron armor of massive stomping Ironclad Bastion golems marching inexorably behind her. Cold cyan twilight contrasted with sinister crimson firelight, hand-painted dark-fantasy cinema, 24fps. Audio: howling arctic wind, heavy rhythmic iron footsteps crunching ice, eerie dark chanting, and brooding low cello.

shots.title: Awakening the Frost Obelisk
shots.speaker: RELIC AWAKENED
shots.caption: Against foes who defy the rules of chess, the Accord alone is not enough. Beneath the glacier, your Court unearths the Frost Obelisk — a forbidden Relic forged before the Board existed.
shots.prompt: Majestic upward tilt and slow orbit around a towering ancient glacial alabaster Frost Obelisk rising out of cracked ice tiles in a frozen mountain pass. Luminous cyan runes ignite sequentially from base to spire, unleashing a shimmering radial frost shockwave that crystallizes swirling snowflakes in mid-air. Standing bravely in the foreground on frosted chess tiles, the Ivory Queen, Knight, and Rook shield their eyes as radiant azure light bathes their carved marble armor. Epic fantasy cinema oil painting aesthetic, 24fps. Audio: deep crystalline ice groaning, resonant harmonic frost chime explosion, and soaring ethereal orchestral choir.

shots.title: Gates of the Crimson Citadel
shots.speaker: MALAKOR, THE UNBOUND KING
shots.caption: The Glacial Rift lies behind you. Ahead rises the Crimson Citadel — charred obsidian squares veined with magma, where Malakor awaits upon the Throne of Ash for a final gambit.
shots.prompt: Sweeping dramatic crane shot rising over a volcanic basalt bridge made of scorched obsidian chessboard squares glowing with molten lava seams underneath. Glowing volcanic embers and black ash drift upward against a blood-red storm sky. Upon the jagged volcanic rampart ahead stands Malakor, the Unbound King, molten crown blazing as he raises his greatsword toward the oncoming camera while vast legions of armored obsidian warriors stir along the bridge below. Dark epic fantasy cinema oil-painted realism, intense orange underlighting, 24fps. Audio: booming siege war drums, crackling volcanic lava rumble, blazing brass fanfare, and distant echoing war horns.

shots.title: The Accord Restored
shots.speaker: CHRONICLE OF AETHELGARD
shots.caption: Checkmate. The Unbound Crown lies cold upon sunlit marble as the Crimson Rift seals on the horizon. Chess and Relic now stand united — guardians of the Sixty-Four Squares.
shots.prompt: Serene slow pull-back and gentle rise from a shattered obsidian crown cooling to dark stone on a sunlit white-and-gold marble chessboard terrace. The last faint wisps of ember smoke fade away into crisp morning air. In the glowing golden background, the Ivory King and Queen stand side by side beside the softly pulsing blue Frost Obelisk, gazing over peaceful sunlit valleys as the last sliver of the red Rift closes into bright golden sunrise clouds. Luminous warm golden-hour lighting, floating sunlit pollen motes, hand-painted epic fantasy cinema, 24fps. Audio: gentle fading wind, triumphant warm major-key orchestral strings and horn resolution, peaceful chime.
